exact_domain.exact_gate: L/gcd(L,C_L) divides r_L, where M_L=lcm(L,Q), C_L=K_{M_L}/M_L, r_L=M_L mod p
exact_domain.payment: Pi_p(L)<Pi_p(A); if the gate passes, require a separate macro E5 check from L to lcm(L,C_L)

conclusion.frozen_atlas: No paid support-monotone same-chart promotion makes the high-R full-excess cofactor gate pass on any of the 31 distinct frozen verified-parent high anchors.
conclusion.controls: The p=1201 control has one paid promoted gate hit, but its unpromoted gate already passes; p=3793 and p=60913 have no paid proper same-chart support lift. Thus the finite evidence does not exhibit a gate rescue from a failing high anchor.
conclusion.proof_boundary: This is a finite arithmetic atlas plus the support-monotone same-chart Pi_p lemma. It neither upgrades legacy parents nor excludes non-divisibility support resets or proves global availability of a cofactor macro.
